title: Play on Mobile
description: A phone-friendly companion view of the canvas: simplified sheet (tap-to-roll, tap-to-move, double-tap-to-target) docked alongside a live, touch-pannable map. Sheet layout and rolls are driven by a per-system JSON descriptor — vagabond ships built in; other systems get a read-only fallback until a descriptor is added for them, either by this module or by the system/module itself via the play-on-mobile API.
